v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Petrus et Ioánnes * ascendébant in templum ad horam oratiónis nonam.
text.en: Peter and John * went up together into the Temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour.

text.la: Argéntum et aurum * non est mihi: quod autem hábeo, hoc tibi do.
text.en: Silver and gold have I none, * but such as I have, give I thee.

text.la: Dixit Angelus ad Petrum: * Circúmda tibi vestiméntum tuum, et séquere me.
text.en: The Angel said unto Peter: * Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.

text.la: Misit Dóminus * Angelum suum, et liberávit me de manu Heródis, allelúia.
text.en: The Lord hath sent * His Angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, alleluia.

text.la: Tu es Petrus, * et super hanc petram ædificábo Ecclésiam meam.
text.en: Thou art Peter * and upon this Rock I will build My Church.

text.la: Misit Heródes rex manus ut afflígeret quosdam de Ecclésia. Occídit autem Iacóbum fratrem Ioánnis gládio. Videns autem quia placéret Iudǽis, appósuit ut apprehénderet et Petrum.
text.en: Herod the King stretched forth his hands, to vex certain of the Church. And he killed James, the brother of John, with the sword. And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded farther to take Peter also.

v.la: In omnem terram exívit sonus eórum.
v.en: Their sound hath gone forth into all the earth:

r.la: Et in fines orbis terræ verba eórum.
r.en: And their words unto the ends of the world.

text.la: Tu es pastor óvium, * Princeps Apostolórum, tibi tráditæ sunt claves regni cælórum.
text.en: Thou art the Shepherd * of the sheep, and the Prince of the Apostles, and unto thee are given the keys of the kingdom of heaven.

text.la: Deus, qui hodiérnam diem Apostolórum tuórum Petri et Pauli martýrio consecrásti: da Ecclésiæ tuæ, eórum in ómnibus sequi præcéptum; per quos religiónis sumpsit exórdium.
text.en: O God, Who didst hallow this day by the Testifying of thine Holy Apostles Peter and Paul, grant unto thy Church, whose foundations Thou wast pleased to lay by their hands, the grace always in all things to remain faithful to their teaching.

office.title: In Vigilia Ss. Petri et Pauli Apostolorum
